findings.description: The hidden span copies all of scopeText(task), labels included, so every backlog row now holds the word 'scope:' and every row with an excluded path holds ' · not '. Typing 'scope' or 'not' into the Backlog filter then matches those rows whatever their goal. Putting only the glob lists in the hidden span (scope and scopeOut joined) would fix it.
